implementation.bframe_contract: B-frames are supported via VideoConfig.b_frames (0..4) and NvencSession has_b_frames (dts = pts - output_duration). Muxer preserves EncodedPacket{pts_us,dts_us} verbatim into AVPacket{pts,dts} then av_packet_rescale_ts on both (1/1e6 → stream time_base). DTS monotonic in written (decode) order per slot is enforced; PTS in written order may go backward when B-frames reorder (e.g., decode I0/P3/B1 has PTS 0,100k,33k but DTS monotonic 0,33k,50k) — accepted after Repair 1. Only DTS>PTS or negative or DTS regression are rejected. Tests cover valid B-frame, reordered PTS, DTS regression, DTS>PTS, negative DTS.
implementation.written_vs_presentation: Written (decode) order is the order packets arrive from encoder and are interleaved via av_interleaved_write_frame — DTS monotonic per slot. Presentation order is sorted by PTS for display — monotonic when sorted, but not in written order when B-frames reorder. Previous PTS monotonic in written order incorrectly rejected valid reordering; Repair 1 enforces DTS monotonic (written) and preserves PTS verbatim, documenting the distinction.
